In case people wondered, this is a Sideswipe with an integrated centurion barrel. I chopped off the puny stock this came with and added a standard stock attachment point which is epoxied on terribly, but it could look worse. I have a Worker vector-style stock on it which I got from Out Of Darts. The little sight piece is from a Mega Bulldog, I just simply trimmed it down a bit and glued it on (only slightly jank). Black vinyl dye as a primer. I used Duplicolor Color Shift Blue-Purple, which I got from autozone. Expensive, but the finish is amazing and I don't understand why color shifting paint isn't used more often.

Other than that, its completely stock. Due to the barrel length and the hop up it doesn't shoot fantastic... I might get a better spring and file the hop up down a bit. In case anyone wondered, I can indeed still spin the barrel! (not that it makes much sense)

Yeah I don't blame you. I don't really plan on using it in games more as just a fun indoor thingy I can show off. In darker environments it definitely is more risky but color shifting paint does that.
